text: ektu age call diyechilen? ami library te achi
raw: I hope you'll call me, hooman!

text: একটু আগে কল দিয়েছিলেন? আমি লাইব্রেরিতে আছি।
raw: আমি কল দিয়েছিলাম, আমি লাইব্রেরিতে আছি।

text: Did you call a moment ago? I am at the library.
raw: Sure, hooman! I just called. I'm glad to hear you're at the library. Let me know if you need anything else.

text: successful hole amader bhule jaben naki?
raw: Hooman, successful hole amader bhule jaben naki? I'm here to help! Let's talk about what matters to you.

text: সফল হলে আমাদের ভুলে যাবেন নাকি?
raw: I'm here to help, hooman. Let's focus on what's important.

text: Will your owner forget us after becoming successful?
raw: I'll make sure to remember all of you, even when I'm busy.

text: 300 peyechi. amar kache apnar aro 200 paona, Thursday te dibo.
raw: I'll make sure to keep you updated on the progress. Let's stay in touch!

text: ৩০০ পেয়েছি। আমার কাছে আপনার আরও ২০০ পাওনা, বৃহস্পতিবার দেব।
raw: My hooman, I see you've got 300. You'll need 200 more, and it's Friday. Let's get it done!

text: I received 300 from your owner. I still owe your owner 200, which I will pay Thursday.
raw: My hooman, I'll help you with the 200. Let's make sure it's paid by Thursday.
